Put Dear ImGui here (it is not part of the Urania repository).

Urania is tested with Dear ImGui 1.92.9b (docking branch). It needs the API with
ImTextureData / ImGuiBackendFlags_RendererHasTextures (version 1.92 or newer).

1. Download Dear ImGui 1.92.9b or newer: https://github.com/ocornut/imgui
   (for example: git clone --depth 1 --branch v1.92.9b-docking https://github.com/ocornut/imgui)
2. Copy only these files into this folder:
       imgui.cpp  imgui.h  imgui_draw.cpp  imgui_internal.h  imgui_tables.cpp  imgui_widgets.cpp
       imconfig.h  imstb_rectpack.h  imstb_textedit.h  imstb_truetype.h  LICENSE.txt
3. Build: python scripts/build_plugin.py

Dear ImGui is MIT licensed. The plugin binary contains it; its license goes into the Urania zip.
